[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] the [[Vehtendi Valley]]. 

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Vehtendi Valley in [[Vabbi]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 750 [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear the Vehtendi Valley in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode."''
